Italian Ministry of Labour official sector tables

method.interpretation: This recovery updates an existing Italian intent owner after Search Console showed that the page still receives impressions but needs a clearer, reproducible operator answer. Official 2026 labour-cost tables validate the subject and inputs; obtained impressions do not represent total market demand.
method.volumePolicy: Volume remains null. No traffic, ranking or conversion forecast is inferred.

gscContext.purpose: Recovery of an existing Italian query owner, not creation of a speculative keyword page.

candidates.signalNote: The page already owns a distinct Italian operator query in the approved keyword map. The Ministry of Labour publishes 2026 sector tables for average hourly labour cost, supporting a practical input-driven answer rather than a generic salary article.
candidates.intentBoundary: This guide owns the company hourly cost of the driver and its allocation to one mission. The broader cost pillar owns all company costs; the kilometre calculator owns route-level numerical execution.
candidates.productFit: RouteBudget lets an operator enter a verified hourly driver cost with distance, fuel, tolls, wear, empty return and margin, then compare a client price against the mission cost.
candidates.productBoundary: RouteBudget does not calculate payroll, net salary, social contributions, official labour-table classifications, live tolls or a universal hourly tariff.
